name: Rowan
trusted_greeting: I saved you a quiet spot, if you want it.
cooldown_greeting: I need some quiet right now.

root.speech: Hello. It's nice to see someone stopping for a moment.

choices.text: Do you know much about the woods?

birds.speech: There are some birds nearby. I'm trying not to scare them.

choices.text: Wouldn't it be easier to get closer?

birds_types.speech: A few little ones. I don't know every name, but I like listening.

choices.text: You don't need to know everything.

birds_close.speech: Maybe. But then I'd just be bothering them for my own curiosity.

choices.text: You worry about animals that much?

birds_kind.speech: Thank you. Most people don't mean any harm; they just forget to be quiet.

choices.text: Do you spend a lot of time out here?

animal_care.speech: Yes. They're easier to understand when you give them space.

choices.text: I think I get what you mean.

forest.speech: I like it out there. Even the paths everyone uses have something different each day.

choices.text: Where do you go to relax?

forest_rest.speech: Usually somewhere with water. I don't need much more than that.

forest_lost.speech: A few times. It's less frightening if you stop walking in circles.

forest_safe.speech: Not always. I leave when the place stops feeling safe. There's no shame in that.

fishing.speech: Sometimes I fish. Mostly I enjoy being near the water.

choices.text: What do you do with a catch?

cooking.speech: I cook when I can. It's a pleasant way to look after yourself.

choices.text: Do you cook for other people?

recipe.speech: Start with something you understand. Bread and a little food over a fire can be plenty.

cook_others.speech: Sometimes. It's nice when somebody actually sits down and eats with you.

choices.text: I don't think I'm very sociable.

cook_invite.speech: I'd like that. We don't need to make a big event of it.

cook_fail.speech: Then you try again. A burnt meal isn't a moral failing.

talk.speech: Of course. Is something on your mind?

choices.text: I'm still not used to this world.
Do you find people difficult sometimes?
Not really. Just wanted to talk.

homesick.speech: That makes sense. You don't have to feel at home straight away.

choices.text: Thanks. I needed to hear that.

rowan_miss.speech: Sometimes. Quiet doesn't mean I never think about the past.

choices.text: You can tell me, if you want.

boundary.speech: Thank you. I'm not ready to talk about all of it yet.

people.speech: I don't mind people. I just need a little quiet between conversations.

choices.text: I get restless if it's too quiet.
Want to sit here for a bit?

smalltalk.speech: That's alright. We don't need a reason to speak.

choices.text: What have you been up to today?
Can we just be quiet for a moment?

quiet.speech: We can just sit here, if you'd like. No need to fill every silence.

choices.text: I think I'd rather keep moving.
Maybe I'll join you another time.
